title: A Hunter's Ledger
author: unsigned
pages:
Third night out. Crypt found by day, as always: they cannot stand the sun, so we go in with it.

Stakes, torches, one priest. No bargains.

The old one was beaten, not killed. He left a bottle of his own blood on the stones. Dark as wine, still warm.

The priest smashed it. He says a man who drinks that under a moon with no light is not bitten, he is welcomed.
Note for the next party: move the coffin if you must, it packs like a chest. They move theirs too.
